title: Curve ball remake
author: Dependent_Yam_1028
selftext:
Saw someone post their 2D version of the game I was making and thought I might as well make a post too.

It’s basically a remake of the old Flash game Curveball, except I made it multiplayer. There’s 1v1, 2v2, and an FFA mode that works like the other person’s version, where each player gets their own wall. That mode definitely needs the most work since getting all the perspectives to feel right is a bit tricky.

I built it as a browser game using TypeScript and Vite, with the actual game running through Canvas and React handling the menus and arcade stuff around it. I started with the regular offline Curveball gameplay, got the physics and controls feeling decent, then integrated it into the arcade and started adding the multiplayer modes. A lot of the work since then has just been testing it, finding all the weird edge cases, and repeatedly adjusting things until it actually feels right.

Anyways, the bigger goal is to have a website that works as an arcade for all my games, then eventually integrate it into Discord Activities so I can just launch it and play with my friends through Discord.

The whole thing actually started because we didn’t want to pay $100 for a Colonist premium subscription, so I said f’ it, I’ll just make Catan myself for free lol.

So now I have Catan and this game on the arcade, with plans to remake a few other old Flash games as multiplayer revisions:

* Pac-Xon
* Line Rider
* Double Wires
* Dogfight: The Great War
* A game that mixes Tanks, the old artillery game, with Crush the Castle

Most of these are done or at least pretty far along. I mostly just need to actually playtest them with people and iron everything out.

Definitely looking for feedback, but honestly I’m also looking for old Flash game bangers that aren’t already on that list and might make an interesting multiplayer game.
